summary_ja: この告示は令和六年三月三十一日から適用し、一部の規定は公布の日から適用する。
summary_en: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2024; certain provisions apply from the date of promulgation.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2024; provided, however, that paragraph (2) of the following Article and Articles 10 through 16 and Articles 18 through 20 of the Supplementary Provisions apply from the date of promulgation.
